rows.title: Library category/book/info
rows.boundary: Prior actual evidence retains its source. This audit neither runs nor aggregates a final gate.
rows.supplied: Original LibraryViewModel, iOSLibraryView and UIKit controller remain owners. Four new finite anchors reveal contents, grouping, downloaded filter and options without executing them.
rows.remaining: Exact category expansion/selected work/book-info/author/narrator and import/update review targets remain unbound. Reader.open covers opening canonical content, not selecting a Library row. Existing user actions still require original functional acceptance.

rows.remaining: Independent text-range selection and exact navigation-slider/book-info/view-options/in-book-search target bindings are not established. A focusLocator is not a proof of arbitrary UIKit selection or complete viewport restoration.

rows.title: Settings subsection/control
rows.boundary: Prior actual evidence retains its source. This audit neither runs nor aggregates a final gate.
rows.supplied: Original SettingsView is retained. Fifteen finite original section/control anchors and parent-then-reveal/focus use exact retained owner, Observation/backend invalidation, real layout and independent visible witness. Semantic Settings-section AppIntent now selects only original installed control entities via the same service.
rows.remaining: Reveal is not value mutation or successful import/install. Dedicated language/accessibility/data-profile Settings pages were historical NOT_IMPLEMENTED placeholders; parent scopes these 'where existing', so this audit does not invent three new pages. Actual HE/EN/accessibility and production data remain required.

rows.title: Tabs/workspace/profile/group
rows.boundary: Prior actual evidence retains its source. This audit neither runs nor aggregates a final gate.
rows.supplied: Original StudyWorkspaceStore/NavigationAdapter, profiles, groups, DuckDuckGo strip, original overview Grid/List and restoration already exist. Two actual parent presentations and nine fixed component anchors were added using original setters and retained source.
rows.remaining: Fixed reveal anchors do not select an arbitrary profile/group/tab or set layout preference. Exact identity/state routes remain missing. Original 3x3/30-tabs, same-book independent locators, mutations, migration, rollback, 100-switch/production restore, multiwindow/rotation and unsaved draft acceptance remain required.
